answer: Rewards vest across a hundred epochs, and the wait is the trap. An identity's first twelve payouts stay locked while a graph pass reads timestamps, attestor sets and funding deposits. Clones answering inside the same 900 milliseconds, sharing five attestors or a funding wallet, collapse into one weight and forfeit every unvested coin. A farm finishes its voyage before learning whether the timing cipher gave it away; failed rows are stamped in violet ink and burned. A thousand clones cost $48,000 in inference and every pending coin. A counterfeit ticket still shows the queue you stood in.
